value.rationale: TARGET-route existence answer to an admitted computable-structure-theory question: whether a computable reduced p-group of finite Ulm length can have a minimal pair in its degree spectrum. The draft proves Yes with n=2 (least length for this socle-vs-pth-powers method), divisible part 0, f0=f1=aleph0, and proves more (every c.e. degree realized, uniformly in p and c.e. index). The object and invariant were motivated before computation by the target, the exact spectrum fact is not known or mechanically implied by Ulm/Pruefer or categoricity results, and a future researcher could reasonably need this precise spectrum fact. It is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration; the incomplete surrounding census is honestly limited to c.e. degrees and does not erase the headline exact result.
